verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar naanak dheau nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|

en.bdb: The formless Lord assumed the form of Guru Nanak Dev who is second all forms.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਗੰਗਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te ga(n)gahu jaan tara(n)g uThaiaa|

en.bdb: In turn, he created Afigad from his limbs as the waves e created by Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: amaradhaas gur a(n)gadhahu jot saroop chalat varataiaa|

en.bdb: From Guru Angad came Guru Amar Das and the miracle of the transference of the light was seen by one and all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur amarahu gur raamadhaas anahadh naadhahu sabadh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: From. Guru ar Das Rim Das came into being in such a way as if the Word was ated from the unstruck sounds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਹੁ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raamadhaasahu arajan guroo dharasan dharapan vich dhikhaiaa|

en.bdb: Guru Arjan Dev by Guru Ram 'Ws was ated as if he is the image of the latter in the mirror.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜਨਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਾਉਂ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: har gobi(n)dh gur arajanahu gur gobi(n)dh naau(n) sadhavaiaa|

en.bdb: Being created by Guru Arjan Dev, Guru Hargobind made himself famous as the form of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmoorat gur sabadh hai saadhasa(n)gat vich paragaTee aaiaa|

en.bdb: In fact the physical body of the Guru is 'Word' of the Guru which comes perceptible only in the form of holy congregation.
Thus, the true liberated the whole world making people bow at the Lord's feet.
